_about: Hand-written test data for C1 (docs/design.md, C1 plan), written once into each new playthrough's history so every screen can be tried before posts are generated (C3). `ago` is game seconds before the playthrough was first seen.

posts.text: Night dive at Laguna Bend. Water's still, city's loud. Some places you just gotta see with your own eyes.

comments.text: Pretty. Still prefer real stars over neon, though.
Judy, you gotta take me out there sometime. V too, hermano.
Quiet spot. Good place to think.
This is giving me lyrics. Mind if I steal the view?

posts.text: Mama Welles made pozole. If you're not at El Coyote Cojo in twenty minutes, it's gone. That's not a threat, it's a promise.
Militech. Peace through strength. Ask about our new line of personal defense systems at any authorized dealer.
Badlands sunset from the ridge. You city types don't know what you're missing.

comments.text: Not all of us are city types.

posts.text: Sound check went long. New track's almost there. Almost.
Arasaka. Security for a safer tomorrow. Our city, protected.

jackie.text: V! Misty says Vik's got a new toy in for you. Swing by when you're done?
On my way after this gig.
Bring an appetite. Mama's cooking tonight.
